title: Nick Sirianni: I've always felt complete support from Jeffrey Lurie

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nick Sirianni: I've always felt complete support from Jeffrey Lurie
sources.description: Nick Sirianni has never missed the playoffs since becoming the Eagles' head coach and he's won one of the two Super Bowls the team has played in during his tenure, but the waters have gotten rockier for him over the last 12 months.
